name: @builderpluss/engine
description: Expression language and computational-geometry library behind parametric floorplans — matrix interpreter, geometry/partitioning/layout algorithms, and chainable Mat / Vec2 / Vec3 / Poly facades. Pure and synchronous: no DOM, no host eval, no I/O.

scripts.//build: ONLY for a non-bundler consumer (a Node service). Consumers here read src/ directly, so a stale dist/ can never shadow an edit — see README.
